"""Fault-inject only transport fixtures in an owned temporary directory."""
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile,shutil,json,importlib.util,base64,sys
module=Path(__file__).with_name('reference_closure.py');spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('closure',module);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);inventory=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text()); results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='reference-controls-',dir=Path(sys.argv[3])) as tmp:
    def case(name,change,accept):
        fixture=Path(tmp)/name;shutil.copytree(root,fixture);change(fixture)
        try: verdict=m.validate(fixture,inventory);ok=True;reason=verdict
        except Exception as e:ok=False;reason=str(e)
        results.append({'case':name,'expected_accept':accept,'actual_accept':ok,'reason':reason});assert ok==accept,name
    case('complete-current-packet',lambda p:None,True)
    for index,record in enumerate(inventory['restored']):
        rel=record['path']
        case('missing-restored-'+str(index),lambda p,r=rel:(p/r).unlink(),False)
    for index,record in enumerate(inventory['restored']):
        rel=record['path']
        case('wrong-bytes-'+str(index),lambda p,r=rel:(p/r).write_bytes(base64.b64encode(b'tampered')+b'\n'),False)
    case('omitted-command-manifest',lambda p:(p/'correction-command-manifest.json').unlink(),False)
    def alter(p):
        name=p/'own-accountability-commands.json';a=json.loads(name.read_text());a[1]['stdout']['sha256']='0'*64;name.write_text(json.dumps(a))
    case('changed-manifest-tuple',alter,False)
print(json.dumps({'cases':results,'positive':1,'negative':10,'scope':'Only owned transport fixtures; no board/runtime/provider execution'}))

                :refs "personal Rheos6;head7ea3f996047e67f6e7c6ae4cc185bbae92f1fc85;review5445787250;root4209801600;threadPRRT_kwDOU4Vf-c6qA45B;cr-comment:v1:14c5694581936735693c1a63;RR154440f3c997aa9208194bba59b5edbef3654f78"
                :note "Four original paired reflection streams recovered without recapture: decoded stdout143/137 bytes and two empty stderr, exact hashes/one-LF grammar.
